text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo! My smooth, flawless skin!
What
happened to you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If they made a mascot of me now, she'd
be
covered in pimples. This is an
emergency.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was fortunate enough to be born
lovely, so
that's how I'd like to be
remembered.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I bet Mom knows a good ointment. Time
to call
the helpline!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan wants to be the ideal
mascot,
looks and all, but her skin is
making that a
challenge today.
